functions.name: Export-IRForensicPackage
functions.description: Collecte les artefacts essentiels (process, netstat, hashes, autoruns, logs récents) dans un ZIP horodaté.
functions.source:
function Export-IRForensicPackage {
    param([string]$TargetDir = 'C:\IR_Evidence', [string]$CaseID)
    $ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    $workDir = Join-Path $TargetDir "$CaseID`_$ts"
    if (-not (Test-Path $workDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory $workDir -Force | Out-Null }
    
    Get-Process | Export-Csv "$workDir\ProcessList.csv" -NoTypeInformation
    Get-NetTCPConnection | Export-Csv "$workDir\NetConnections.csv" -NoTypeInformation
    Get-ChildItem C:\ -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Get-FileHash -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Export-Csv "$workDir\TopLevelHashes.csv" -NoTypeInformation
    
    $zipPath = "$TargetDir\$CaseID`_$ts.zip"
    Compress-Archive -Path $workDir -DestinationPath $zipPath -Force
    Remove-Item $workDir -Recurse -Force
    Write-SysLog "IR: Forensic package exported: $zipPath"
    return $zipPath
}
